tokens.name: color-frame
tokens.usage: Hairline around the app shell. Derived: canvas darkened, so every theme gets one.

tokens.name: color-bubble
tokens.usage: Segmented and tab containers, small pills on canvas. Derived from inset and surface.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Static outlines: panels, rows, inputs at rest.

tokens.name: border-default
tokens.usage: Icon wells and pills that need definition.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Focused non-edge-light inputs.

tokens.name: text-on-light
tokens.usage: Text and icons on any aurora surface (≥7:1).

tokens.name: accent-success
tokens.usage: Vivid success badge fill in the activity feed (with dark check).

tokens.name: accent-blue-soft
tokens.usage: Blue at small sizes: dots under 6px, quick-action icons.

tokens.name: accent-amber-soft
tokens.usage: Awaiting approval at small sizes (dots).

tokens.name: accent-violet
tokens.usage: Category: queued. Icons and flares (≥1.5px strokes).

tokens.name: accent-danger
tokens.usage: Notification badge and the solid fill of a destructive confirm button.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Label on accent-danger fills (4.9:1).

tokens.name: solid-dark
tokens.usage: Solid dark pill: the primary action on an aurora card.

tokens.name: backdrop
tokens.usage: Behind overlays (slide-over, dialog, command palette), with a light 8px blur.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Poppins for Latin and numerals, IBM Plex Sans Arabic for Arabic (the browser falls back per glyph). Weights 300–600; never bold. Arabic runs about 1.1× the Latin size.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Body 15px / 1.6 for Arabic. Hierarchy by size and color, not weight.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Rail tooltips, chips, search placeholder, table rows.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Meta lines, timestamps, table headers, “View all”.

groups.name: Code
groups.note: Logs, hashes, versions and YAML. Always LTR.

radius.note: Containers tighten as they nest (28 → 16 → 12 → 10); controls are pills or circles.

tokens.usage: Tiny tags.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Icon tiles inside rows.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Rows, inputs, chips, log viewer.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: The app frame.

tokens.name: radius-pill

shadow.note: No grey drop shadows under cards. Cards are lit from above; only data and the approval moment glow.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Every card: a 1px top highlight.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Slide-over, dialog and palette over the backdrop.
